# Composer reply bar — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the composer reply bar when the draft answers a message and the reader should see which one. `replyTo` is the required author-plus-excerpt pair — without it there is no bar — and the pair reads as one unit, the quoted context above the field being composed. The dismiss control is labelled, so its purpose survives icon-only rendering, and dismissal reports through `onDismissReply`: the host clears the reply target and the bar only asks. There is no editing here and no thread model — the bar quotes, the draft field composes, and one quoted message at a time means stacking quotes is the host's.
